title: 帝王賞の後に・ツギツ（ハ）ギ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Smart Falcon's victory in the Teio Sho, she's steadily bringing to life her promised winning streak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in the back of her mind, it still bothers her that the hype has yet to reach the level of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, student council president Symboli Rudolf, the famed seven-crown champion, shows up to acknowledge Smart Falcon's contributions to dirt racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon's next race is the JBC Classic, and her determination is all the stronger after hearing the president's expectations for her.
